scenes.title: Sela's offer
scenes.summary:
Sela Thorn offers to row the party toward the old chapel in daylight and says she will return at first light tomorrow.
She says Saltmere Mine flooded when the bell first rang forty years ago, and recalls her grandmother's account of warm water.

scenes.title: Hymn pages in the mine
scenes.summary:
The party enters the mine and finds warm black water and hymn-book pages; one page bears the penciled name "M. Brand", which Teo identifies as his sister Mira's handwriting.
Vessa and Oren suspect harbor-master Maren is involved with the cult or choir, but their search finds no further evidence.

scenes.title: The fishermen's warning
scenes.summary:
The party returns to Gullwick by dusk and visits the shore near the drowned chapel despite Sela's warning.
An unnamed fisherman warns that the Kelp Mother drags children under the water; the GM presents this as the fishermen's claim.

scenes.title: The midnight bell
scenes.summary:
At midnight the submerged bell rings twelve times, with louder humming; the GM notes that the choir clock is at three of six.
Pale shapes stand in rows on the submerged chapel floor and vanish when the bell stops; the party leaves.

scenes.title: Tomorrow's dive
scenes.summary:
The party plans to have Sela row them out at first light and dive to the chapel at low tide in daylight, seeking Mira; Vessa plans to buy rope and another lantern.
Bram gives them stew and says Maren has a good heart and lost a brother to the bay; the session ends at the inn.
